verdict.rationale: Abacum claims it runs AI inside the financial model, so answers are grounded in the model rather than free-form LLM output (abacum-docs-2, abacum-docs-1). It also says statements built from live ERP actuals are traceable (abacum-docs-9), with edit history on data models (abacum-docs-13). The evidence is only marketing copy, there is no agent-facing interface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404 (abacum-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented programmatic or agent access (API/MCP) for asking finance questions, explicit per-figure lineage on AI answers, specifics on runway/variance Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
